name: sample_rows
command:
import csv,json
for f in ['battles.csv','battle_forces.csv','battle_casualties.csv','wars.csv','commanders.csv','factions.csv','sources.csv']:
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(f,encoding='utf-8')))
    pick={'battles.csv':'battle_of_ayacucho_b','battle_forces.csv':'battle_of_ayacucho_b','battle_casualties.csv':'battle_of_ayacucho_b','wars.csv':'spanish_american_wars_of_independence','commanders.csv':'antonio_de_sucre','factions.csv':'peru_bolivian_confederation','sources.csv':'quinto-centenario-1985'}[f]
    print(json.dumps({'file':f,'rows':[r for r in rows if pick in (r.get('slug'),r.get('battle_slug'))]},ensure_ascii=False))
